verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents campaign (broadcast) analytics a developer can pull into a warehouse: per-broadcast stats (recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, rates), batch stats for a page of broadcasts, per-link click performance, and account-level email and growth stats. It also documents cursor pagination up to 1000 per page and 5 years of email stats retention. However, nothing in the evidence shows API endpoints for flow, sequence or automation performance metrics, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: flow/sequence/automation performance metrics endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of warehouse/dashboard export use.
